notes.title: 'Spank Me Harder' DLC issue is fixed
notes.notes:
Sinners, we finally got some support and as of earlier today the issue has been fix. if the DLC didn't automatically downloaded for you please try the following:

1. Use ‘Task Manager’ to kill Steam.exe
2. Launch Steam.exe
3. Select SinVR and uninstall the ‘Spank Me Harder’ DLC, then reinstall it

This will install the DLC and everything should work.
Thank you for your patience and have a Sinful holiday.

notes.title: Settings Menu now has resolution and full screen buttons.
notes.notes:
Sinners,
We've had requests from several players to add settings for different screen resolution and full screen toggle.
So we just pushed an update that will have these options on your settings menu. Just click Esc to show it or click the icon on the top left corner.
Please let us know if you run into any issues.
Thanks,
SinVR
